changelog:
v1.26.1 - **Launcher now survives engine upgrades.** The updater previously downloaded only the game `.pck`; when the engine version changed (4.6→4.7) the still-installed old `maranza_game.exe` couldn't load the new-format `.pck` and the loading bar hung at 0% (*"Couldn't load project data… is the .pck missing?"*). `launcher.gd` now reads `engine_version`/`exe_url` from `version.json` and re-downloads the game `.exe` whenever the engine changes — normal content updates stay fast pck-only downloads — staging both files to `.tmp` and committing them together so a failed update never leaves a mismatched exe/pck pair. `export.yml` publishes `maranza_game.exe` as a release asset and writes `engine_version` (pinned once via `env.GODOT_VERSION`) + `exe_url` into `version.json`. NOTE: existing installs need a one-time full re-install of this release to pick up the new launcher; future engine bumps are then automatic.
v1.26.0 - Ported the game to **Godot 4.7** (from 4.6.2) with a 4.7-powered visual pass and a critical loading-screen fix. **Engine:** bumped both projects' `config/features` and the CI version pins (headless tests + release export) to 4.7.0, and fixed two 4.7 breaks — `StandardMaterial3D.specular` → `metallic_specular` (Blood/Death VFX) and a UTF-16 scratch script re-encoded to UTF-8. **New 4.7 visuals:** the cooldown overlay's remaining-time wedge is now a smooth conic `GradientTexture2D` (was a 48-vertex polygon); a visual-only `Control` offset-transform pulses the HP bar like a heartbeat below 33% HP without reflowing the HUD; the explosion gains 3D particle motion (spark billboard spin + smoke `use_rotation_velocity_3d` tumble); and overhead/arm streetlight fixtures are now rectangular `AreaLight3D`s for softer pooled light. **Fix — loading bar stuck at 0%:** in Godot 4.7 a global `class_name`'s static members can be left unresolved when a referencing script compiles early or on a worker thread, which stalled the IntroScene's threaded preload of `PlayScene.tscn` forever (the bar never left 0% even though enemies/audio ran). `CentroMapGenerator` is now a `preload`-const dependency (no `class_name`) in PlayScene/Prop/PropSpawner so its statics always resolve, and `GameState` preloads synchronously without the redundant `PlayScene.tscn`. Verified: headless suite 10/10, real-renderer PlayScene generation (25 chunks), and a clean game boot.
v1.25.8 - Playtest fixes — Borsello defense readout + Scudo MDMA shield VFX: (1) the damage-taken HUD chip now reads as a positive **"Damage Reduction: +XX%"** instead of the confusing "Defense: -XX%" (sign flipped for both the chip total and the per-source hover tooltip, covering the multiplicative `dmg_taken_mult` and additive `dmg_reduction` sources). (2) The Scudo MDMA shield no longer renders as a "solid blue" ball: a leftover emissive `_shield_dome` (StandardMaterial3D sphere, radius 1.2) was overlapping and occluding the new refractive `PlayerShieldVFX` bubble — only briefly visible in the one-frame gap as `shield_hp` hit 0. Removed the dome entirely, redirected the per-hit red flash to pulse the bubble's `energy_color` (new `Player._flash_shield_hit`), nudged the bubble's `core_opacity` 0.45→0.30 for the requested extra transparency, and made the shader material `resource_local_to_scene` so the flash only tints the player's own bubble. Generator (`tools/build_effects.gd`) updated to match the hand-edited scene. Verified: clean headless `--import` + `test_powers`/`test_balance` pass.
